arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Doss argued that challenges to execution procedures belong in civil rights actions.
Mr. Shanmugam argued that failing to name an alternative equates to challenging the sentence itself.
Justice Scalia questioned the practical implications of allowing repeated challenges to new methods.
Justice Souter inquired about the specific injunctive relief requested by the side that brought the case.
